title: Search Registered Owners
text: The system shall allow users to search for registered pet owners.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall return matching owner records when a valid owner last name is supplied.
The system shall handle an owner search when no registered owner matches the supplied last name.
The system shall allow a matching owner record to be selected for detailed viewing.

title: Handle Owner Search Results
text: The system shall present owner search results according to the number of matching owners.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall display owner search results when multiple owners satisfy the supplied search criterion.
The system shall allow the details of a uniquely matched owner to be viewed.
The system shall provide an observable no-match outcome when an owner search returns no records.

title: Register New Owner
text: The system shall allow a new owner to be registered using valid owner information.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall create a new owner when all mandatory owner information is valid.
The newly created owner shall receive a persistent owner identifier.
The newly created owner shall be available through the owner workflow after successful registration.

title: Update Owner Information
text: The system shall allow stored information of an existing owner to be updated.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall persist valid changes made to an existing owner's information.
The system shall preserve the owner identifier when owner information is updated.
The system shall display the updated owner information after a successful update.

title: View Owner Details
text: The system shall provide detailed information for a selected registered owner.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall display the stored information of the selected owner.
The system shall display pets associated with the selected owner.
The system shall display available visit information associated with the selected owner's pets.

title: Validate Owner Information
text: The system shall validate owner information before creating or updating an owner record.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall reject an owner submission when mandatory owner information is missing.
The system shall provide validation feedback when invalid owner information is submitted.
An invalid owner submission shall not create or persist a valid owner record.

title: Register New Pet
text: The system shall allow a new pet to be registered under an existing owner.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall create a pet record when valid pet information is submitted for an existing owner.
The created pet shall remain associated with the owner under whom it was registered.
The newly registered pet shall be visible in the selected owner's information.

title: Update Pet Information
text: The system shall allow information of an existing pet to be updated.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall persist valid changes made to an existing pet's information.
The pet shall remain associated with the same owner after its information is updated.
The system shall display the updated pet information after a successful update.

title: Validate Pet Information
text: The system shall validate pet information before creating or updating a pet record.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall reject a pet submission when mandatory pet information is missing.
The system shall provide validation feedback when invalid pet information is submitted.
An invalid pet submission shall not create or persist a valid pet record.

title: Preserve Owner-Pet Association
text: The system shall preserve the relationship between a pet and its registered owner.

acceptance_criteria.text: A newly registered pet shall reference the owner under whom the pet was created.
Updating pet information shall not silently change the pet's owner association.
The associated pet shall remain visible from the corresponding owner details.

title: Register Veterinary Visit
text: The system shall allow a veterinary visit to be recorded for an existing pet.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall create a visit when valid visit information is supplied for an existing pet.
The newly created visit shall remain associated with the selected pet.
The newly created visit shall become visible in the selected pet's visit history.

title: Validate Veterinary Visit Information
text: The system shall validate visit information before a veterinary visit is recorded.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall reject visit creation when mandatory visit information is missing.
The system shall provide validation feedback when invalid visit information is submitted.
An invalid visit submission shall not create a valid visit record.

title: View Pet Visit History
text: The system shall provide historical visit information for a registered pet.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall display recorded visits associated with the selected pet.
Each displayed visit shall remain associated with the correct pet.
A newly created valid visit shall be included in the pet's subsequent visit history.

title: List Veterinarians
text: The system shall provide users with information about veterinarians available in the application.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall return the available veterinarian records.
Each veterinarian record shall expose the veterinarian's name.
The veterinarian listing shall be available through the supported veterinarian listing workflow.

title: Display Veterinarian Specialties
text: The system shall expose specialty information associated with veterinarians.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall display specialty information when specialty information exists for a veterinarian.
Specialty information shall remain associated with the correct veterinarian.
A veterinarian without a recorded specialty shall remain valid in the veterinarian listing.

title: Repeated Authentication Failure Protection
text: The system shall protect user accounts from repeated unsuccessful authentication attempts.

acceptance_criteria.text: The account shall become locked after five consecutive failed authentication attempts and remain locked for 30 minutes.
A successful authentication before the lockout threshold is reached shall reset the failed-attempt counter.
Authentication shall be rejected while the account remains locked.

title: Password Reset Token Validation
text: The system shall allow a password to be reset using a secure single-use reset token.

acceptance_criteria.text: A valid unused reset token shall allow the user to set a new password.
A reset token shall expire 30 minutes after it is issued.
The system shall reject an expired or previously consumed reset token.

title: Administrative Authorization
text: The system shall restrict administrative account actions to authorized administrative users.

acceptance_criteria.text: An authenticated administrator shall be allowed to perform an administrative account action.
A non-administrator shall be denied access to administrative account actions.
A denied administrative action shall not modify the target account.

title: File Upload Validation
text: The system shall validate uploaded files before accepting them for processing.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall accept an allowed file type when the file size is exactly 5 MB.
The system shall reject an uploaded file when its size is greater than 5 MB.
The system shall reject an uploaded executable file type.

title: Audit Administrative Account Actions
text: The system shall create an auditable record of sensitive administrative account actions.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall record an audit event when an administrator changes the state of a user account.
The audit event shall identify the administrator, target account, performed action, and event timestamp.
A successful administrative account action shall have a corresponding audit record.

title: Owner Search Response Performance
text: The owner search operation shall remain responsive under concurrent workload.

acceptance_criteria.text: The owner search operation shall maintain a p95 response time below 2 seconds with 100 concurrent users for 10 minutes.
The owner search operation shall maintain a failed-request rate below 1 percent with 100 concurrent users for 10 minutes.
The owner search workload shall complete without an unhandled application failure during the 10-minute test period.

title: Veterinarian Listing Performance
text: The veterinarian listing operation shall provide predictable response performance under load.

acceptance_criteria.text: The veterinarian listing operation shall maintain a p95 response time below 1500 milliseconds with 100 concurrent users for 10 minutes.
The veterinarian listing operation shall maintain a failed-request rate below 1 percent during the defined workload.
The veterinarian listing workload shall run for 10 minutes at the specified load before its performance evidence is considered complete.

title: Visit Registration Performance
text: The visit registration operation shall complete within an acceptable response time under concurrent usage.

acceptance_criteria.text: The visit registration operation shall maintain a p95 response time below 2 seconds with 50 concurrent users for 10 minutes.
The visit registration operation shall maintain a failed-request rate below 1 percent during the defined workload.
Successful visit registrations completed during the performance test shall remain persistently available after the test run.

title: Reliability Under Sustained Workload
text: The application shall continue operating reliably during sustained workload.

acceptance_criteria.text: The application shall complete a 30-minute sustained workload test without an unhandled application failure.
The application shall maintain a failed-request rate below 1 percent during the 30-minute sustained workload test.
The application shall remain responsive at the end of the sustained workload test.

title: Monthly Service Availability
text: The deployed application shall maintain a high level of operational availability.

acceptance_criteria.text: The deployed application shall achieve at least 99.9 percent availability during each calendar month.
Availability evidence shall distinguish scheduled maintenance from unexpected service unavailability.
Availability evidence shall identify the measurement period used to calculate monthly availability.

title: Concurrent User Capacity
text: The application shall support concurrent user activity without unacceptable service degradation.

acceptance_criteria.text: The application shall support 100 concurrent users for 10 minutes without an unhandled application failure.
The application shall maintain a p95 response time below 3 seconds while serving 100 concurrent users for 10 minutes.
The application shall maintain a failed-request rate below 1 percent while serving 100 concurrent users for 10 minutes.

title: Form Validation Usability
text: The application shall provide understandable feedback when a user submits invalid form information.

acceptance_criteria.text: The application shall display validation feedback when a mandatory form field contains invalid information.
Validation feedback shall identify the field or input condition that requires correction.
Valid information already entered by the user shall remain available when the form is returned for correction where technically applicable.

title: Keyboard Accessible Form Interaction
text: Core data-entry workflows shall support keyboard-based interaction.

acceptance_criteria.text: A user shall be able to reach interactive controls in the core owner form using keyboard navigation.
A user shall be able to submit the core owner form without requiring a pointing device.
Validation feedback for the core owner form shall be programmatically associated with the corresponding invalid input where supported by the interface technology.

title: Protection of Sensitive Operational Information
text: The application shall avoid exposing sensitive operational information through ordinary error responses and logs.

acceptance_criteria.text: Ordinary client-facing error responses shall not expose application credentials.
Ordinary client-facing error responses shall not expose database connection secrets.
Application logs used for QA evidence shall not intentionally record plaintext authentication credentials.

title: Maintainability of Validation Logic
text: Core validation and business-rule logic shall remain testable and maintainable.

acceptance_criteria.text: The selected core validation and business-rule package shall achieve at least 80 percent line coverage in the configured coverage report.
The selected core validation and business-rule package shall have no unresolved critical-severity static-analysis finding in the configured analysis run.
The evidence used to evaluate maintainability shall record the analysis tool and tool version.
